findings.text: the debt sentence reports 21 documents as 7 with an unclosed section and 19 with a repeated header: my scan of the docs tree at 7f37baec reads 21 flagged documents, 19 carrying a duplicate header but only 3 carrying a section-unclosed (7 findings across those 3 documents), so the sentence names 7 documents where the run's own listing shows 3 and oversizes the repair work it hands downstream.

the balance scan swallows every exception and returns an empty finding list, so a scanner crash reports as a balanced document and is indistinguishable from a clean audit - a fail-open guard of the same confident-wrong-answer shape this check was added to remove.

justifications.durability: tests/test_doccheck_structure.py:41 fails if the unclosed-section report regresses and tests/test_doccheck_structure.py:89 if the duplicate header does; I reproduced all seven must-fail cases against the unrepaired source and the six silent cases passing at both revisions.
justifications.evidence: the base/head cohort reproduces exactly (7 failed / 41 passed with reckon/doccheck.py at 4a628c8f, same seven ids; 48 passed at head, exit 0) and the specimen, severity and exit-code readings are confirmed independently, but the headline debt figure reads a findings count as a documents count, which misstates the repair scope.
justifications.fit: the scanner follows the module's Finding/severity idiom and the codes and helper names are mechanism-named with no plan labels, but reckon/doccheck.py:589 swallows every exception into an empty finding list.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/doccheck.py:569 _structure_findings reports an unclosed section and a stray close as errors and a second header as a warn, and reckon/doccheck.py:633 wires it into audit_html; run live, the specimen at the run's revision reports 1 error (section-unclosed, id=s2-roster-write-commits) plus 1 warn, and my synthetic specimens report exit 1 on the two error cases and exit 0 on the warn.
justifications.scope_discipline: both commits are pure insertions (94 and 147 lines in 92be14fd, 48 and 18 in 7f37baec by --numstat) and every path is one of the four declared write paths, with nothing unrelated carried.
